# AgentKit
Lightweight tool-call tracer for AI agents (stdlib only, zero deps).

## Run
python app.py  # serves :8000

## API
- POST /trace {tool,args,ms,error}
- GET /traces
- GET /stats -> calls, errors, avg_ms

- GET /footprint -> per-tool calls, compute time, estimated energy Wh (WATTS env, default 200W)

## Example
curl -XPOST localhost:8000/trace -d '{"tool":"search","ms":120}'

## Roadmap
per-tool stats. Done: persistence (traces.jsonl), `@traced` decorator in client.py.
